# Kenji Pinlac

> Personal portfolio and blog: HTB writeups, CTF challenges, and a build log.

This site hosts writeups for retired HackTheBox machines and CTF event challenges, a blog about building this site, and a resume.

## Sections

- [/](https://reimo22.github.io/) — Home page with recent posts and writeups
- [/about/](https://reimo22.github.io/about/) — Profile and resume
- [/writeups/](https://reimo22.github.io/writeups/) — HackTheBox machines and CTF challenges
- [/blog/](https://reimo22.github.io/blog/) — Blog posts including the site build log
- [/feed.xml](https://reimo22.github.io/feed.xml) — RSS feed for blog posts
- [/sitemap.xml](https://reimo22.github.io/sitemap.xml) — XML sitemap

## Tech stack

- Eleventy 3 (Node, static site generator)
- Hand-written CSS with custom-property tokens (light / dark themes)
- Plain JS: command palette, theme toggle, code-copy buttons
- Node `node:test` + jsdom for unit/DOM tests
- GitHub Actions CI (lint, html-validate, Lighthouse, lychee) → deploy to Pages
